title: listen to ... look at ... etc. (verb + preposition)
summary: Глаголы, которые всегда идут с определённым предлогом: **listen to, look at, wait for, talk to, ask for, think about, belong to**.
ru:
## Глагол + предлог
Многие английские глаголы требуют определённого предлога перед дополнением. Часто он не совпадает с русским: мы говорим «слушать музыку» (без предлога), а англичане — **listen to** music.

## Самые частые пары
- **listen to** — слушать: *Do you **listen to** the radio?*
- **look at** — смотреть на: *Look **at** this photo!*
- **wait for** — ждать: *I'm **waiting for** the bus.*
- **talk / speak to** (с кем) **about** (о чём): *I **talked to** Anna **about** the party.*
- **ask (someone) for** — просить что-то: *He **asked** me **for** some money.*
- **think about / of** — думать о: *I'm **thinking about** my holiday.*
- **belong to** — принадлежать: *This bag **belongs to** Kate.*
- **look for** — искать: *I'm **looking for** my keys.*
- **depend on** — зависеть от: *It **depends on** the weather.*
- **laugh at** — смеяться над: *Don't **laugh at** me!*
- **pay for** — платить за: *Who's **paying for** the tickets?*
- **write to** — писать кому-то: *I **wrote to** my friend.*

## Предлог не нужен
Некоторые глаголы предлога не требуют: **call, phone, ask (a question), answer**.
> I'm **waiting for** you. — Я жду тебя. (русс. без предлога, англ. — for)
> **Call** me tonight. — Позвони мне вечером.
> She **asked** me a question. — Она задала мне вопрос.

## Местоимения после предлога
После предлога ставим **me, you, him, her, it, us, them**.
> Listen **to me**. · Look **at her**. · Wait **for us**.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I listen music every day.~~ → I **listen to** music every day.
- ~~Look to me!~~ → Look **at** me!
- ~~I'm waiting you.~~ → I'm waiting **for** you.
- ~~I'm looking my keys.~~ → I'm looking **for** my keys.
- ~~She said me about it.~~ → She **told** me about it. / She **spoke to** me about it.
en:
## Verb + preposition
Many verbs are followed by a fixed preposition. Learn them together.

## Common pairs
- **listen to**: *Do you **listen to** the radio?*
- **look at**: *Look **at** this photo!*
- **wait for**: *I'm **waiting for** the bus.*
- **talk / speak to** (someone) **about** (something): *I **talked to** Anna **about** the party.*
- **ask (someone) for**: *He **asked** me **for** some money.*
- **think about / of**: *I'm **thinking about** my holiday.*
- **belong to**: *This bag **belongs to** Kate.*
- **look for**: *I'm **looking for** my keys.*
- **depend on**: *It **depends on** the weather.*
- **laugh at**: *Don't **laugh at** me!*
- **pay for**: *Who's **paying for** the tickets?*

## No preposition
Some verbs take no preposition: **call / phone / ask (a question) / answer (someone)**.
> **Call** me tonight.
> She **asked** me a question.

## Pronouns after prepositions
Use **me, you, him, her, it, us, them**: *Listen **to me**. Look **at her**. Wait **for us**.*

## Common mistakes
- ~~I listen music.~~ → I **listen to** music.
- ~~Look to me!~~ → Look **at** me!
- ~~I'm waiting you.~~ → I'm waiting **for** you.
- ~~I'm looking my keys.~~ → I'm looking **for** my keys.
structure:
## Формула
> Подлежащее + **глагол + предлог** + дополнение
> I **listen to** music. · We **wait for** the bus. · She **looks at** the picture.

## Таблица
| Глагол + предлог | Значение |
|---|---|
| listen to | слушать |
| look at | смотреть на |
| look for | искать |
| wait for | ждать |
| talk to + about | говорить с + о |
| ask for | просить (что-то) |
| think about | думать о |
| belong to | принадлежать |
| depend on | зависеть от |
| pay for | платить за |

## Вопросы и отрицания
> Who **are you waiting for**? (предлог — в конце вопроса)
> What **are you looking at**? · What **do you listen to**?
> I **don't belong to** that club.

## Запомните
- В вопросе предлог остаётся **после глагола / в конце**: ~~For who~~ → Who ... **for**?
- Без предлога: **call, phone, ask a question, answer**.

exercises.title: Вставьте предлог
exercises.instruction: Вставьте нужный предлог: **to, at, for, about, on**.

items.text: Why are you looking {{at}} me like that?
I often talk {{to|with}} my grandmother on the phone.
Don't laugh {{at}} him. He's trying his best.

exercises.title: Предлог или ничего
exercises.instruction: Вставьте предлог или **—**, если он не нужен.

items.text: Please call {{—|-}} me when you arrive.
She asked {{—|-}} me a difficult question.
Don't worry. I'll wait {{for}} you here.

items.q: I like to listen ___ music in the evening.
Can I ask you ___ a pen?
items.why: **ask (someone) for** — просить что-то: ask you **for** a pen.

exercises.title: Составьте предложения
exercises.instruction: Составьте предложение из слов в скобках (Present continuous или Present simple по смыслу).

answers: I am waiting for the train.
She is looking at the map.
They are talking about the film.
We are listening to the radio.
This book belongs to my sister.

exercises.title: Вопросы с предлогом
exercises.instruction: Составьте вопрос с предлогом в конце.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями о себе. Проверьте по образцу.

items.prompt: What music do you listen to?
items.sample: I listen to pop music and sometimes jazz.

items.prompt: Who do you often talk to on the phone?
items.sample: I often talk to my mother on the phone.

items.prompt: What are you looking for right now? (or: What do you usually look for and can't find?)
items.sample: I'm often looking for my keys.

items.prompt: What do you think about before you sleep?
items.sample: I usually think about the next day.
